content.stem: 以下哪些潜在可疑活动的指标通常与高风险业务部门和结构(如空壳公司)相关？(选择三项。)

options.A: 已知所涉商品或服务（如能确定）与该公司的业务画像或金融活动性质不符
options.B: 所有支付金额均低于报告门槛，但累计起来数额较大，同时仍符合标准商业惯例
options.C: 一家公司经常与长期合作的业务伙伴在中等风险的司法管辖区进行大额交易，并提供完整的文件和审计追踪记录
options.D: 无法通过搜索或直接询问获取足够信息来识别资金转账的发起人或受益人
options.E: 支付款项未注明用途，未提及商品或服务，或者仅提及合同或发票编号

content.stem_en: Which of the following indicators of potentially suspicious activity are commonly associated with high-risk business sectors and structures such as shell companies? (Select Three.)

options_en.A: Knowing the goods or services, if identified, do not match the profile of the company or the nature of the financial activity
options_en.B: All payments are in smaller amounts below reporting thresholds but are high when aggregated, while still being consistent with standard business practices
options_en.C: A company regularly conducts large-volume transactions in a medium-risk jurisdiction with longstanding business partners and provides complete documentation and audit trail records
options_en.D: Insufficient information is available through searches or direct inquiries to identify the originator or beneficiary of funds transfers
options_en.E: Payments have no stated purpose, do not reference goods or services, or only reference a contract or invoice number
